summary: A cluster of half-formed singers that drift between the ash pillars, repeating a hymn that never reaches its last verse.
emotional_origin: The village choir broke apart the winter the sickness came. They stopped singing together and never agreed on how the hymn was supposed to end.
revealed_trait: The unfinished final verse — the note it never learned to sing.
revelation_hint: It always stops mid-phrase before it strikes. The silence is the tell, not the sound.
release_requirement: Learn the missing verse from the choir mistress before the confrontation.
reconcile_requirement: Discover why the choir stopped, and let the Choir finish the hymn during the Revelation.
journal_entry_on_discovery: Something is singing in the ash fields. Three voices, maybe more. They keep stopping at the same bar, every time, like a page torn out of the middle of a song.
journal_entry_on_understanding: It is not trying to frighten anyone. It is trying to remember. The Choir broke apart before the hymn ended and it has been repeating the part it knows ever since. If I can give it the last verse, it may simply stop.
